GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, running on took over approaching 100m and drew clear # All honours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Over-raced  throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length sat last rail 4l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3l off, off heels 200m, hit line well final 100m # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered on jumping. Raced keenly through the middle stages and passing the 600m was steadied when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Raced keenly 5th on rail (3L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 600m. Chasing on rail (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 350m & gave ground on inside in last 300m. # didn't finish off

Jumped Ok Quickly Improved 3l 3rd. 4l away chasing 600m as runnerup shot Clear . closed Turn . Straightened Up 2 Lengths away, Battled On Well but couldn't reach Leader , No Match winner # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was inclined to lay outwards whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to turn then Hooked Out to 4 Lengths 3 Wide , shifted widest Straightening Up , Made Some Ground in Straight in a blanket finish (2.3 Lengths 1st-to-last). [Stewards: Overraced fiercely approaching/rounding first turn. Raced keenly middle stages. Hung out approaching/rounding home turn. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality. Warning placed on it for hanging out.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied when buffeted between runners on jumping. Overraced fiercely app & rounding 1st turn. Raced wide, with cover, throughout the middle stages & continued to race keenly. Hung out approaching and rounding the home turn, running wide on the track. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality. Warning issued.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair bustled caught 4 Wide 3 Lengths off, still 4 Wide 2 Lengths off midrace, pushed along turning, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on well to the line considering tough run # 3-4 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped rnr. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Raced wide without cover from the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground until 3 Wide @ @ 550m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & outsprinted in last 200m. Vetted clear. # Didn't quicken.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Just Ok Settled Down 3 Wide No Cover Mid Field 5l Off travelled 3 Wide No Cover Mid Field to Turn Straightened Up Eased out Under Pressure Middle Of Track 8L off plain to line # wide/plain run
